subject: ADR-238: the next bird says what it will carry -- the selection log says what the next individual will be logged as, and says so when a tap on a selected dial clears it
body: The eighth blind trial pressed adult for the third bird while it was still selected; the press cleared the dial and A3 was logged with no age, with nothing on the page saying so. The dials carry forward and a re-press clears, both on purpose; together they were a trap. The page now shows what the next individual will be logged as after every press, says in words when a tap has cleared a dial, and names in the add confirmation what the record is missing. Task 133 to 138 confirmed, verify_sel 83 to 95 held against the record KEEP keeps, new mutate_sel runner.
